landing.heroTitle: Avoid climate losses in your operation. With 24 hours notice.
landing.heroSub: Alerts and forecasts for agriculture, mining and lifting in Chile. If frost or wind is a risk, you get notice in time — not the next day.
landing.innovSub: Not just dashboards: concrete services to expand your operation.
landing.innov1Body: Hourly wind traffic light and site thresholds.
landing.innov2Body: ICAP, episodes and ops for Copiapó / Mantos basins.
landing.innov3Body: Email/WhatsApp and ops board across mines.
landing.liveSubPanel: Same readout as the main dashboard · avocado threshold · OpenMeteo
landing.liveAlertRest: Temperature below bloom damage threshold. Activate anti-frost irrigation before 03:30.
landing.liveFallback: API unavailable; showing a sample with the same dashboard thresholds.
landing.frostActionHigh: Temperature below damage threshold. Check anti-frost irrigation and alerts in the panel.
landing.frostActionMed: Watch: min T° near threshold. Monitor in the agriculture panel.
landing.accessDesc: The same secure JWT entry as before: weather, agriculture and valley monitoring panel.
landing.accessHint: Access is by authorized account. Request credentials from your METGO admin.
landing.modulesDesc: Each module answers a specific operational decision to protect your profitability.
landing.featFrostBody: A frost that generic forecasts missed can cost an entire season's harvest. METGO alerts you 12–24h ahead with data from your exact zone, not the nearest DMC station.
landing.featEtBody: A crane or operation stopped by wind costs thousands of dollars per hour. METGO gives you an hourly operational traffic light so you can plan with real margins, not assumptions.
landing.featSprayBody: Complying with DS 59 without continuous monitoring is flying blind. METGO integrates a station network, real-time dashboard, and reports for audits, all in one platform.
landing.featPdfBody: PDF weather record per event for crop insurance and field traceability.
landing.howTitle: From the operation to the decision
landing.howDesc: Three steps from registering your operation to the alert you get in the field.
landing.step1Body: We define the coordinates of your operation and the critical thresholds for your site.
landing.step2Body: Our model processes data specific to your location, updated every 15 minutes.
landing.step3Body: You receive a WhatsApp or email notification just before the weather crosses your risk thresholds.
landing.step4Body: Act, delay or protect — and keep a PDF event report for documentation.
landing.alertsDesc: Clear signals to act on time, aligned with your site's thresholds.
landing.alertWarnDesc: Approaching threshold. Preventive alert for shift teams.
landing.alertBadDesc: Projected threshold crossing. Activate safety protocols and document the event.
landing.faq1q: Do I need my own sensors to start?
landing.faq1a: No. You can start with our data sources and hyperlocal models; your own sensors can be integrated later.
landing.faq2a: Request a demo and we will create an account for you. Then you can securely sign in to your panels.
landing.faq3q: What do I see after login?
landing.faq3a: You will see panels specific to your sector, whether agriculture, mining, lifting, or air quality, with your configured alerts.
landing.ctaSub: Start making decisions with real data today.
